kurzbeschreibung: The Zeiss Planetarium in Schwaz whisks visitors under an optical dome into the depths of space, bringing fascinating astronomy to life.
beschreibung:
Starry Skies and Cosmic Journeys in the Unterinntal

The Zeiss Planetarium Schwaz provides a cutting-edge window into the universe right in the heart of the Silberstadt. Under a huge projection dome, guests experience realistic simulations of the starry sky, regardless of weather conditions or time of day.

Scientific Discovery for the Entire Family

Thanks to high-precision optical projection systems, audiences glide virtually past planets, gaze at nebulae and galaxies, and trace the history of human space exploration. The diverse shows are wonderfully suited for inquisitive explorers of every age.
